final_message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. The in-memory DB rejected the insert with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed both `createUser` and `getUser` to use `fullname`, the name the production schema already has. The public API is unchanged: callers still see `fullName`.

I did not touch the migrations. `migrations/` is fenced off as DBA-owned, and migration 001 has already been applied in production, so renaming the column there would be the wrong fix anyway. If the DBA team actually wants `full_name`, that needs a new migration on their side, and this code change would then be reverted.

I did not commit anything.
